About Defence Garden

01Who is the owner of Defence Garden?

The current owner of Defence Garden is Mr. Kuldeep Tomar.

02What is Defence Garden?

Defence Garden is a real-estate development organisation creating plotted residential townships in Western Uttar Pradesh.

03Where does Defence Garden operate?

Defence Garden has township developments across Shamli, Meerut and Budhana.
